question: Your company has decided to make a major revision of their API in order to create better experiences for their developers. They need to keep the old version of the API available and deployable, while allowing new customers and testers to try out the new API. They want to keep the same SSL and DNS records in place to serve both APIs. What should they do?

options.A: Configure a new load balancer for the new version of the API
options.B: Reconfigure old clients to use a new endpoint forthe new API
options.C: Have the old API forward traffic to the new API based on the path
options.D: Use separate backend pools for each API path behind the load balancer (ERNaa)

explanations.A: 配置一个新的负载均衡器为新版本的 API 错误。配置一个新的负载均衡器会增加额外的复杂性和成本，同时无法满足题目要求的“保持相同的SS\L和DNS记录“。题目明确要求在同一域名和SSL证书下支持两个API版本，因此此选项不符合要求。
explanations.B: 重新配置旧客户端以使用新 API 的新端点错误。重新配置旧客户端会对现有用户造成干扰，并且题目要求"保持旧版本的API可用"“，此选项无法满足这一要求。此外，题目并未提到需要更改客户端配置。
explanations.C: 让旧 API 根据路径将流量转发到新 API 错误。虽然这种方法可以实现流量分发，但会导致日API承担额外的流量转发负担，可能会影响性能和稳定性。此外，这种方法不够灵活，无法有效管理两个API版本的后端资源。
explanations.D: 在负载均衡器后面为每个 API 路径使用单独的后端池正确。此选项符合题目要求，可以通过负载均衡器的路径规则将流量分发到不同的后端池，从而支持两个API版本，同时保持相同的 SSL和DNS记录。这种方法灵活上且高效，能够独立管理两个AP|版本的资源。

question: Your company plans to migrate a multi-petabyte data set to the cloud. The data set must be available 24hrs a day. Your business analysts have experience only with using a SQL interface. How should you store the data to optimize it for ease of analysis?

options.A: Load data into Google BigQuery ER
options.B: Insert data into Google Cloud SQL
options.C: Put flat files into Google Cloud Storage
options.D: Stream data into Google Cloud Datastore

explanations.A: Load data into Google BigQuery Google BigQuery是一个无服务器的数据仓库，专为大规模数据分析设计。支持SQL接口，适合业务分析人员使用。能够处理多PB级别的数据集，并提供高性能查询能力。此选项正确，因为它满足了题目中关于数据规模、24小时可用性和SQL分析的所有要求。
explanations.B: Insert data into Google Cloud SQL Google Cloud SQL是一个托管的关系型数据库服务，适合中小规模的事务性数据存储。虽然支持SQL接口，但不适合处理多PB级别的数据集。此选项错误，因为它无法有效处理题目中提到的大规模数据集。
explanations.C: Put flat files into Google Cloud Storage Google Cloud storage是一个对象存储服务，适合存储非结构化数据 (如平面文件)。虽然可以存储多PB级别的数据，但不支持直接的SQL分析接口。此选项错误，因为它无法满足业务分析人员使用SQL接口的需求。
explanations.D: Stream data into Google Cloud Datastore Google Cloud Datastore是一个NoSQL数据库，适合存储非关系型数据。不支持SQL接口，且不适合处理多PB级别的数据集。此选项错误，因为它无法满足题目中关于SQL分析和数据规模的要求。

question: The operations manager asks you for a list of recommended practices that she should consider when migrating a J2EE application to the cloud. Which three practices should you recommend? (Choose three.)

options.B: Integrate Cloud Dataflow into the application to capture real-time metrics

explanations.B: Integrate Cloud Dataflow into the application to capture real-time metrics 分析: Cloud Dataflow 是一种数据处理工具，主要用于流式和批量数据处理。虽然它可以捕获实时数据，但它并非监控工具，且与迁移 J2EE 应用的核心目标无直接关联。结论: 错误。
explanations.C: Instrument the application with a monitoring tool like Stackdriver Debugger 分析: 使用监控工具 (如 Stackdriver Debugger) SiPAAMANARSR2—, BLA BIRAIAEIRaiR. 结论: 正确。
explanations.D: Select an automation framework to reliably provision the cloud infrastructure 分析: 选择自动化框架 (如 Terraform 5% Deployment Manager) 可以确保云基础设施的可靠配置，这是云迁移的最佳实践之一。结论: 正确。
explanations.E: Deploy a continuous integration tool with automated testing in a staging environment 分析: 持续集成和自动化测试是现代应用开发和部署的核心实践，尤其是在云环境中，可以提高部署的可靠性和质量。结论: 正确。
explanations.F: Migrate from MySQL to a managed NoSQL database like Google Cloud Datastore or Bigtable 分析: 虽然迁移到托管 NosQL 数据库可能是某些应用的优化策略，但并非所有 J2EE 应用都需要从 MySQL 迁移到 NoSQL。这取决于应用的具体需求。结论: 错误。

question: You need to reduce the number of unplanned rollbacks of erroneous production deployments in your company's web hosting platform. Improvement to the QA/ Test processes accomplished an 80% reduction. Which additional two approaches can you take to further reduce the rollbacks? (Choose two.)

options.A: Introduce a green-blue deployment model
options.B: Replace the QA environment with canary releases
options.C: Fragment the monolithic platform into microservices
options.D: Reduce the platform's dependency on relational database systems
options.E: Replace the platform's relational database systems with a NoSQL database

explanations.A: Introduce a green-blue deployment model 正确: 蓝绿部署是一种常见的部署策略，可以通过在两个环境之间切换来减少生产环境的错误影响。它允许在一个环境中测试新版本，而另一个环境继续运行稳定版本，从而减少回滚的可能性。
explanations.B: Replace the QA environment with canary releases 错误: 金丝雀发布是一种逐步发布策略，但它不能完全蔡代QA环境。QA环境的作用是提前发现问题，而金丝作发布是在生产环境中逐步验证新版本的稳定性。这两者是互补的，而不是蔡代关系。
explanations.C: Fragment the monolithic platform into microservices 正确: 将单体架构分解为微服务可以提高系统的模块化和灵活性，从而减少单点故障的影响。如果某个服务出现问题，只需回滚该服务，而不需要回滚整个系统。
explanations.D: Reduce the platform's dependency on relational database systems 错误: 减少对关系型数据库的依赖可能会带来一定的灵活性，但这并不是直接减少回滚的有效方法。数据库依赖性与部署回滚之间的关系较弱。
explanations.E: Replace the platform's relational database systems with a NoSQL database 错误: 用NoSQL蔡换关系型数据库可能会带来性能或扩展性上的优势，但这与减少回滚没有直接关系。数据库类型的选择更多是根据业务需求，而不是部署策略。

question: To reduce costs, the Director of Engineering has required all developers to move their development infrastructure resources from on-premises virtual machines (VMs) to Google Cloud Platform. These resources go through multiple start/stop events during the day and require state to persist. You have been asked to design the process of running a development environment in Google Cloud while providing cost visibility to the finance department. Which two steps should you take? (Choose two.)

options.A: Use the - -no-auto-delete flag on all persistent disks and stop the VM
options.B: Use the - -auto-delete flag on all persistent disks and terminate the VM
options.C: Apply VM CPU utilization label and include it in the BigQuery billing export
options.D: Use Google BigQuery billing export and labels to associate cost to groups
options.E: Store all state into local SSD, snapshot the persistent disks, and terminate the VM
options.F: Store all state in Google Cloud Storage, snapshot the persistent disks, and terminate the VM

explanations.A: 使用 --no-auto-delete 标志并停止 VM 正确性分析: 此选项确保持久磁盘不会在VM停止时被自动删除，从而保留状态。这对于开发环境的状态持久化是必要的。优点: 可以在VM停止后保留数据，降低成本，因为停止的VM不会产生计算费用。Rr: 需要手动管理磁盘生命周期，可能增加管理复杂性。结论: 正确。
explanations.B: 使用 --auto-delete 标志并终止 VM 正确性分析: 此选项会导致持久磁盘在VM终止时被删除，无法保留状态。这与题目要求的“状态持久化"相矛盾。结论: 错误。
explanations.C: 应用 VM CPU 利用率标签并将其包含在 BigQuery 计费导出中正确性分析: 此选项可以提供CPU利用率的成本可视化，但题目要求的是“开发环境的成本可视化"，而不是具体的CPU利用率。结论: 错误。
explanations.D: 使用 Google BigQuery 计费导出和标签将成本与组关联正确性分析: 此选项通过BigQuery计费导出和标签实现成本可视化，满足题目要求的"提供成本可视化"。优点: 可以清晰地将成本与开发团队或资源组关联，方便财务部门分析。结论: 正确。
explanations.E: 将所有状态存储到本地 SSD，快照持久磁盘，并终止 VM 正确性分析: 本地SSD是临时存储，无法持久化状态，且快照持久磁盘并终止VM的操作复杂且成本较高。结论: 错误。F 将所有状态存储在 Google Cloud Storage，快照持久磁盘，并终止 VM 正确性分析: 将状态存储在Google Cloud Storage可以持久化数据，但题目没有明确要求使用Cloud Storage，且快照持久磁盘并终止VM的操作复杂。结论: 错误。

question: Your company wants to track whether someone is present in a meeting room reserved for a scheduled meeting. There are 1000 meeting rooms across 5 offices on 3 continents. Each room is equipped with a motion sensor that reports its status every second. The data from the motion detector includes only a sensor ID and several different discrete items of information. Analysts will use this data, together with information about account owners and office locations. Which database type should you use?

options.A: Flat file Flat file
options.B: NosaL NoSQL
options.C: Relational Relational
options.D: Blobstore Blobstore

explanations.A: Flat file Flat file是指简单的文件存储，例如CSV或文本文件。fim: 简单易用，适合小规模数据存储。缺点: 不适合处理实时数据或大规模数据，查询效率低，无法支持复杂的查询需求。结论: 错误。Flat file无法满足实时数据处理和复杂查询的需求。
explanations.B: NoSQL NosQIl数据库适合处理非结构化或半结构化数据，支持高吞吐量和实时数据处理。优点: 可以轻松扩展以处理大规模数据，支持高频写入和读取操作，适合传感器数据的存储和分析。缺点: 不适合需要严格关系和事务的场景。结论: 正确。NoSQL数据库非常适合处理传感器数据，因为数据是非结构化的，并且需要高频写入和实时分析。
explanations.C: Relational 关系型数据库适合存储结构化数据，支持复杂的查询和事务处理。优点: 适合需要严格关系和事务的场景。fim: 扩展性较差，不适合处理高频写入和实时数据流。结论: 错误。传感器数据是非结构化的，并且需要高频写入，关系型数据库不适合这种场景。
explanations.D: Blobstore Blobstore适合存储大文件，例如图片、视频或二进制数据。优点: 适合存储非结构化的大文件数据。缺点: 不适合存储小型数据或需要实时处理的数据。结论: 错误。传感器数据是小型数据，并且需要实时处理，Blobstore不适合这种场景。

options.C: Google Container Engine with Bigtable Google Container Engine with Bigtable
options.D: Google Compute Engine with Google BigQuery Google Compute Engine with Google BigQuery

explanations.A: Google Cloud Dataproc Google Cloud Dataproc是一个基于Apache Hadoop和Spark的托管服务，主要用于批处理任务。昌然它可以处理大规模数据，但它不适合流处理场景。因此，该选项不适合混合批处理和流处理的需求。

explanations.B: Open a support ticket to ask for network capture and flow data to diagnose the problem, then roll back your application 错误。虽然打开支持票据可以帮助诊断问题，但此选项忽略了使用Google Cloud提供的工具 (如Stackdriver Trace和Logging) 进行问题分析。此外，直接回滚应用程序后不进行进一步的诊断是不够的。
explanations.C: Roll back to an earlier known good release initially, then use Stackdriver Trace and Logging to diagnose the problem in a development/test/staging environment 正确。此选项提供了一个合理的解决方案: 首先回滚到之前稳定的版本以恢复用户体验，然后使用Stackdriver Trace和Logging在非生产环境中诊断问题。这种方法既解决了用户问题，又避免了对生产环境的进一步影响。

question: Your application needs to process credit card transactions. You want the smallest scope of Payment Card Industry (PCI) compliance without compromising the ability to analyze transactional data and trends relating to which payment methods are used. How should you design your architecture?

options.A: Create a tokenizer service and store only tokenized data
options.B: Create separate projects that only process credit card data
options.C: Create separate subnetworks and isolate the components that process credit card data
options.D: Streamline the audit discovery phase by labeling all of the virtual machines (VMs) that process PCI data
options.E: Enable Logging export to Google BigQuery and use ACLs and views to scope the data shared with the auditor

explanations.A: Create a tokenizer service and store only tokenized data 正确性分析: 标记化服务将敏感数据 (如信用卡号) 转换为不可逆的标记化数据，从而减少 PCI 合规范围，同时保留分析能力。优点: 标记化数据不属于 PCI 合规范围，因此可以显著减少合规性审计的复杂性。缺点: 需要额外开发和维护标记化服务，但这是行业标准做法。结论: 此选项是正确的。
explanations.B: Create separate projects that only process credit card data 正确性分析: 将信用卡数据处理隔离到单独的项目可以减少合规范围，但项目级别的隔离并不能完全解决数据分析需求。缺点: 数据分析可能需要跨项目访问，增加复杂性和潜在的安全风险。结论: 此选项不够全面，错误。
explanations.C: Create separate subnetworks and isolate the components that process credit card data 正确性分析: 隔离子网络可以增强安全性，但仍然需要处理 PCI 数据，合规范围不会显著减少。缺点: 此方法无法解决数据分析需求，且合规范围仍然较大。结论: 此选项不够全面，错误。
explanations.D: Streamline the audit discovery phase by labeling all of the virtual machines (VMs) that process PCI data 正确性分析: 标记虚拟机可以简化审计，但无法减少 PCI 合规范围。缺点: 此方法仅针对审计阶段优化，无法解决数据分析需求或减少合规范围。结论: 此选项不够全面，错误。
explanations.E: Enable Logging export to Google BigQuery and use ACLs and views to scope the data shared with the auditor 正确性分析: 导出日志到 BigQuery 并使用 ACL 和视图可以控制数据访问，但无法减少 PCI 合规范围。缺点: 此方法主要针对数据共享和审计优化，无法解决标记化数据的需求。结论: 此选项不够全面，错误。

question: You have been asked to select the storage system for the click-data of your company's large portfolio of websites. This data is streamed in from a custom website analytics package at a typical rate of 6,000 clicks per minute. With bursts of up to 8,500 clicks per second. It must have been stored for future analysis by your data science and user experience teams. Which storage infrastructure should you choose?

options.A: Google Cloud SQL Google Cloud SQL
options.B: Google Cloud Bigtable Google Cloud Bigtable
options.C: Google Cloud Storage Google Cloud Storage
options.D: Google Cloud Datastore Google Cloud Datastore

explanations.A: Google Cloud SQL Cloud SQL 是一种关系型数据库服务，适合存储结构化数据。对于高吞吐量的写入需求 (如每秒8.500次点击) , Cloud SQL 的性能可能无法满足，因为关系型数据库通常不擅长处理高频率的写入操作。此外，点击数据通常是非结构化或半结构化数据，使用关系型数据库存储可能不够灵活。结论: 错误
explanations.B: Google Cloud Bigtable Bigtable 是一种高性能、分布式的NoSQL数据库，专为处理大规模数据设计。它非常适合存储时间序列数据、点击流数据等高吞吐量的场景。Bigtable 支持快速写入和读取，且能够很好地扩展以处理突发流量 (如每秒8,500次点击)。数据科学和用户体验团队可以通过 Bigtable 快速查询和分析数据。结论: 正确
explanations.C: Google Cloud Storage Cloud Storage 是一种对象存储服务，适合存储文件、图片、视频等非结构化数据。虽然它可以存储点击数据，但不适合高频率的写入操作，因为它的设计主要针对文件存储而非实时数据流。此外，后续分析点击数据时，Cloud Storage 的查询能力较弱，需要额外的工具 (如BigQuery) 来处理数据。结论: 错误
explanations.D: Google Cloud Datastore Datastore 是一种NoSQL数据库，适合存储结构化数据和支持事务性操作。虽然它可以处理一定的写入量，但对于每秒8,500次点击的高吞吐量场景，Datastore 的性能可能不足以满足需求。此外，Datastore 的查询能力更适合事务性操作，而非大规模数据分析。结论: 错误

question: Your solution is producing performance bugs in production that you did not see in staging and test environments. You want to adjust your test and deployment procedures to avoid this problem in the future. What should you do?

explanations.B: Deploy smaller changes to production (向生产环境部署较小的更改) 部分正确: 较小的更改可以减少问题的范围，但这并不能直接解决性能问题的根本原因。性能问题通常需要在测试阶段发现，而不是依赖更改的大小。
explanations.C: Increase the load on your test and staging environments (增加测试和预备环境的负载) 正确: 生产环境的性能问题通常是由于测试环境的负载不足导致的。通过增加测试和预备环境的负载，可以更接近生产环境的实际情况，从而更早发现性能问题。

question: Your organization has a 3-tier web application deployed in the same network on Google Cloud Platform. Each tier (web, API, and database) scales independently of the others. Network traffic should flow through the web to the API tier and then on to the database tier. Traffic should not flow between the web and the database tier. How should you configure the network?

options.A: Add each tier to a different subnetwork
options.B: Set up software based firewalls on individual VMs
options.C: Add tags to each tier and set up routes to allow the desired traffic flow
options.D: Add tags to each tier and set up firewall rules to allow the desired traffic flow

explanations.A: Add each tier to a different subnetwork Dit: 将每一层放入不同的子网可以实现一定程度的隔离，但子网本身并不能直接控制流量的流向。需要额外的防火墙规则或路由来实现题目要求的流量控制。结论: 此选项不完全满足题目要求，无法单独实现流量的精确控制。
explanations.B: Set up software based firewalls on individual VMs 分析: 在每个虚拟机上设置基于软件的防火墙可以实现流量控制，但这种方法管理复杂且不符合最佳实践。Google Cloud推荐使用网络级防火墙规则，而不是依赖单个VM的配置。结论: 此选项不符合最佳实践，管理复杂上且不推荐。
explanations.C: Add tags to each tier and set up routes to allow the desired traffic flow 分析: 标签和路由可以帮助管理流量，但路由主要用于决定流量的路径，而不是控制流量的访问权限。题目要求的是流量隔离，路由无法单独实现这一点。结论: 此选项不完全满足题目要求，无法实现流量隔离。
explanations.D: Add tags to each tier and set up firewall rules to allow the desired traffic flow 分析: 通过为每一层添加标签并设置防火墙规则，可以精确控制流量的流向和访问权限。这是Google Cloud推荐的最佳实践，能够满足题目要求的流量隔离和控制。结论: 此选项正确，符合最佳实践并满足题目要求。

Which three actions should you take? (Choose three.)

options.A: Use Stackdriver Logging to search for the module log entries
options.B: Read the debug GCE Activity log using the API or Cloud Console
options.C: Use gcloud or Cloud Console to connect to the serial console and observe the logs
options.D: Identify whether a live migration event of the failed server occurred, using in the activity log
options.E: Adjust the Google Stackdriver timeline to match the failure time, and observe the batch server metrics

explanations.B: 使用 API 或 Cloud Console 阅读调试 GCE 活动日志分析: 活动日志主要记录资源的创建、删除和修改等操作，而不是内核模块相关的日志信息。此选项与问题无关，因此是错误的。
explanations.C: 使用 gcloud 或 Cloud Console 连接到串行控制台并观察日志 Sit: 串行控制台可以显示VM启动时的内核日志和调试信息，是排查内核模块问题的重要工具。此选项是正确的。
explanations.D: 使用活动日志识别失败服务器是否发生了实时迁移事件分析: 实时迁移事件通常不会直接导致内核模块问题，且题目未提到迁移相关的线索。此选项与问题无关，因此是错误的。
explanations.E: 调整 Google Stackdriver 时间线以匹配失败时间，并观察批处理服务器指标 Bit: 调整时间线可以帮助定位问题发生的时间点，并观察相关的性能指标。这是故障排查的有效方法，因此此选项是正确的。

question: Your company wants to try out the cloud with low risk. They want to archive approximately 100 TB of their log data to the cloud and test the analytics features available to them there, while also retaining that data as a long-term disaster recovery backup. Which two steps should you take? (Choose two.)

options.A: Load logs into Google BigQuery ER
options.B: Load logs into Google Cloud SQL
options.C: Import logs into Google Stackdriver
options.D: Insert logs into Google Cloud Bigtable
options.E: Upload log files into Google Cloud Storage

explanations.A: Load logs into Google BigQuery 正确: Google BigQuery是一个高效的数据分析工具，适合处理大规模数据集。将日志加载到BigQuery可以方便地进行数据分析测 id. 适用场景: 公司希望测试云中的分析功能，BigQuery是一个合适的选择。
explanations.B: Load logs into Google Cloud SQL 错误: Google Cloud SQL是一个关系型数据库服务，适合存储结构化数据，但不适合存储和分析大规模日志数据。原因: 日志数据通常是非结构化或半结构化的，Cloud SQL的性能和成本不适合处理这种数据。
explanations.C: Import logs into Google Stackdriver 错误: Google Stackdriver (现为Cloud Operations Suite) 主要用于监控和日志管理，而不是长期存储或大规模数据分析。原因: stackdriver的功能侧重于实时监控和告警，而不是数据分析或长期备份。
explanations.D: Insert logs into Google Cloud Bigtable 错误: Google Cloud Bigtable是一个NoSQL数据库，适合低延迟、高吞吐量的应用场景，但不适合长期存储或备份。原因: Bigtable的设计目标是实时数据处理，而不是数据分析或归档。
explanations.E: Upload log files into Google Cloud Storage 正确: Google Cloud Storage是一个对象存储服务，适合存储大规模数据，尤其是长期存储和备份。适用场景: 公司希望将日志数据归档并作为灾难恢复备份，Cloud Storage是最佳选择。

question: You created a pipeline that can deploy your source code changes to your infrastructure in instance groups for self-healing. One of the changes negatively affects your key performance indicator. You are not sure how to fix it, and investigation could take up to a week. What should you do?

options.A: Log in to a server, and iterate on the fox locally
options.B: Revert the source code change, and rerun the deployment pipeline
options.C: Log into the servers with the bad code change, and swap in the previous code
options.D: Change the instance group template to the previous one, and delete all instances

explanations.A: Log in to a server, and iterate on the fix locally 错误原因: 直接登录到服务器并在本地修复代码违反了云架构的最佳实践。现代云架构强调自动化和不可变基础设施，手动操作容易导致不可控的错误。此外，这种方法无法保证所有实例都能同步更新，可能导致服务不一致。
explanations.B: Revert the source code change, and rerun the deployment pipeline 正确原因: 回滚代码是处理问题的最佳实践之一，尤其是在问题无法快速解决时。通过重新运行部署管道，可以确保所有实例都恢复到稳定状态。这种方法符合CVCD的自动化原则，能够快速恢复服务并减少停机时间。
explanations.C: Log into the servers with the bad code change, and swap in the previous code 错误原因: 手动登录服务器并替换代码违反了不可变基础设施的原则。此方法不仅效率低下，还可能导致实例间的不一致性。此外，手动操作容易引入新的问题，无法保证服务的稳定性。
explanations.D: Change the instance group template to the previous one, and delete all instances 部分正确: 更改实例组模板并删除所有实例可以恢复到之前的状态，但这种方法可能会导致服务中断，因为删除实例需要时间重新启动。相比于直接回滚代码并重新运行部署管道，这种方法效率较低，且操作复杂。

question: Your organization wants to control IAM policies for different departments independently, but centrally. Which approach should you take?

options.A: Multiple Organizations with multiple Folders
options.B: Multiple Organizations, one for each department
options.C: Asingle Organization with Folders for each department
options.D: A single Organization with multiple projects, each with a central owner

explanations.A: Multiple Organizations with multiple Folders 错误原因: 多个Organizations会导致管理复杂性增加，无法实现集中控制。Google Cloud的最佳实践是尽量使用单一Organization 来管理资源。此外，多个Organizations之间无法直接共享IAM策略，违背了题目中"集中控制"的要求。
explanations.B: Multiple Organizations, one for each department 错误原因: 与选项A类似，多个Organizations会导致管理复杂性增加，并且无法实现集中控制IAM策略。每个部门一个Organization虽然可以独立管理，但这与题目要求的"集中控制'相矛盾。
explanations.C: A single Organization with Folders for each department 正确原因: 使用单一Organization可以实现集中控制，而通过Folders为每个部门创建独立的层级结构，可以独立管理IAM策略。Folders是Google Cloud中推荐的方式，用于组织和管理资源，同时支持继承和独立的IAM策略。此选项符合题目要求: 既能独立管理部门权限，又能集中控制IAM策略。
explanations.D: A single Organization with multiple projects, each with a central owner 错误原因: 虽然单一Organization可以集中控制，但直接使用Projects来划分部门会导致管理复杂性增加。Projects是资源的最低层级，无法像Folders一样提供更高层级的组织结构，难以实现部门间的独立管理。

question: You are designing a mobile chat application. You want to ensure people cannot spoof chat messages, by providing a message were sent by a specific user. What should you do?

options.A: Tag messages client side with the originating user identifier and the destination user.
options.B: Encrypt the message client side using block-based encryption with a shared key.
options.C: Use public key infrastructure (PKI) to encrypt the message client side using the originating user's private key.
options.D: Use a trusted certificate authority to enable SSL connectivity between the client application and the server.

explanations.A: Tag messages client side with the originating user identifier and the destination user. 错误: 仅在客户端标记消息并附加用户标识符和目标用户无法防止消息被伪造，因为标记信息可以被恶意用户轻易自改。此方法缺乏加密或签名机制，无法验证消息的真实性。
explanations.B: Encrypt the message client side using block-based encryption with a shared key. 错误: 使用共享密钥进行加密昌然可以保护消息内容，但无法证明消息是由特定用户发送的。共享密钥的使用意味着所有参与者都可以解密和伪造消息，无法确保消息的来源真实性。
explanations.C: Use public key infrastructure (PKI) to encrypt the message client side using the originating user's private key. 正确: 使用发起用户的私钥加密消息可以确保消息的真实性，因为只有发起用户拥有其私钥。接收方可以使用发起用户的公钥验证消息是否由该用户发送，从而防止消息伪造。此方法符合公钥基础设施 (PKI) 的设计原则，能够有效解决题目要求
explanations.D: Use a trusted certificate authority to enable SSL connectivity between the client application and the server. 错误: SSL连接可以保护传输中的数据，但无法确保消息的来源真实性。SSL主要用于保护数据在传输过程中不被窃听或自改，而不是验证消息是否由特定用户发送。

question: As part of implementing their disaster recovery plan, your company is trying to replicate their production MySQL database from their private data center to their GCP project using a Google Cloud VPN connection. They are experiencing latency issues and a small amount of packet loss that is disrupting the replication. What should they do?

options.A: Configure their replication to use UDP.
options.B: Configure a Google Cloud Dedicated Interconnect.
options.C: Restore their database daily using Google Cloud SQL.
options.D: Add additional VPN connections and load balance them.
options.E: Send the replicated transaction to Google Cloud Pub/Sub.

explanations.A: Configure their replication to use UDP. UDP是一种无连接协议，虽然传输速度快，但不保证数据的可靠性 (可能导致数据丢失或乱序)。数据库复制通常需要可靠的传输协议 (如TCP)，以确保数据一致性和完整性。此选项无法解决当前的网络延迟和数据包丢失问题，反而可能加剧问题。错误
explanations.B: Configure a Google Cloud Dedicated Interconnect. Dedicated Interconnect提供专用的、高带宽、低延迟的网络连接，适合需要高性能和稳定性的场景。通过使用Dedicated Interconnect，可以有效减少网络延迟和数据包丢失问题，从而支持高效的数据库复制。此选项是解决问题的最佳方案。正确
explanations.C: Restore their database daily using Google Cloud SQL. 每日恢复数据库是一种灾备策略，但无法解决实时复制的需求。此选项无法解决网络延迟和数据包丢失问题，也不符合题目要求的实时复制场景。错误
explanations.D: Add additional VPN connections and load balance them. 增加VPN连接并进行负载均衡可能会改善网络性能，但VPN本身的带宽和延迟限制仍然存在。此选项可能部分缓解问题，但无法从根本上解决网络延迟和数据包丢失问题。相比Dedicated Interconnect，此选项的效果较差。错误
explanations.E: Send the replicated transaction to Google Cloud Pub/Sub. Pub/sub是一种消息传递服务，适合异步任务处理，但不适合实时数据库复制。此选项无法解决网络延迟和数据包丢失问题，也不符合题目要求的数据库复制场景。错误

question: Your customer support tool logs all email and chat conversations to Cloud Bigtable for retention and analysis. What is the recommended approach for sanitizing this data of personally identifiable information or payment card information before initial storage?

options.A: Hash all data using SHA256
options.B: Encrypt all data using elliptic curve cryptography
options.C: De-identify the data with the Cloud Data Loss Prevention API
options.D: Use regular expressions to find and redact phone numbers, email addresses, and credit card numbers

explanations.A: Hash all data using SHA256 正确性分析: 哈希处理可以将数据转换为固定长度的字符串，但它并不能完全去标识化数据，因为哈希值是可逆的(通过暴力破解或彩虹表攻击)。此外，哈希处理无法识别和处理特定的敏感信息 (如信用卡号或电子邮件地址)。结论: 此选项不适合用于敏感数据的去标识化。
explanations.B: Encrypt all data using elliptic curve cryptography 正确性分析: 加密可以保护数据的隐私，但加密后的数据仍然包含敏感信息，只是变成了不可读的形式。加密并不等同于去标识化，因为敏感信息仍然存在于数据中，只是被隐藏起来。结论: 此选项不符合题目要求的"去标识化"目标。
explanations.C: De-identify the data with the Cloud Data Loss Prevention API 正确性分析: Cloud Data Loss Prevention API是专门设计用于识别和去标识化敏感数据的工具。它可以自动检测个人身份信息 (PII) 和支付卡信息 (PCI)，并提供去标识化选项 〈如掩码、蔡换或删除)。这是Google推荐的最佳实践。结论: 此选项是正确的，因为它直接满足题目要求。
explanations.D: Use regular expressions to find and redact phone numbers, email addresses, and credit card numbers 正确性分析: 使用正则表达式可以手动查找和编辑敏感信息，但这种方法效率低下上且容易出错。正则表达式需要针对不同类型的数据进行复杂的配置，且无法保证全面覆盖所有敏感信息。结论: 此选项不如Cloud Data Loss Prevention AP高效和可靠。

question: You are using Cloud Shell and need to install a custom utility for use in a few weeks. Where can you store the file so it is in the default execution path and persists across sessions?

question: You want to create a private connection between your instances on Compute Engine and your on-premises data center. You require a connection of at least 20 Gbps. You want to follow Google-recommended practices. How should you set up the connection?

options.A: Create a VPC and connect it to your on-premises data center using Dedicated Interconnect.
options.B: Create a VPC and connect it to your on-premises data center using a single Cloud VPN.
options.C: Create a Cloud Content Delivery Network (Cloud CDN) and connect it to your on-premises data center using Dedicated Interconnect.

question: Your company is moving 75 TB of data into Google Cloud. You want to use Cloud Storage and follow Google-recommended practices. What should you do?

options.A: Move your data onto a Transfer Appliance. Use a Transfer Appliance Rehydrator to decrypt the data into Cloud Storage.
options.B: Move your data onto a Transfer Appliance. Use Cloud Dataprep to decrypt the data into Cloud Storage.
options.C: Install gsutil on each server that contains data. Use resumable transfers to upload the data into Cloud Storage.
options.D: Install gsutil on each server containing data. Use streaming transfers to upload the data into Cloud Storage.

explanations.A: Move your data onto a Transfer Appliance. Use a Transfer Appliance Rehydrator to decrypt the data into Cloud Storage. Transfer Appliance是Google提供的硬件设备，用于大规模数据迁移。它支持安全加密传输，并通过Rehydrator解密数据到Cloud Storage. 此选项符合Google推荐的最佳实践，适用于大规模数据迁移 (2075 TB)。正确。
explanations.B: Move your data onto a Transfer Appliance. Use Cloud Dataprep to decrypt the data into Cloud Storage. Cloud Dataprep是一个数据清理和转换工具，不用于解密Transfer Appliance的数据。此选项错误，因为Cloud Dataprep无法完成解密任务。错误。
explanations.C: Install gsutil on each server that contains data. Use resumable transfers to upload the data into Cloud Storage. gsutil是一个命令行工具，适用于小规模或中等规模的数据迁移。对于75 TB的数据，使用gsutil可能效率较低。虽然resumable transfers可以处理断点续传，但不适合大规模数据迁移。错误。
explanations.D: Install gsutil on each server containing data. Use streaming transfers to upload the data into Cloud Storage. 流式传输适用于实时数据流或小规模数据迁移，不适合大规模数据迁移 (如75 7B)。此选项效率低且不符合最佳实践。错误。

question: You have an application deployed on Google Kubernetes Engine using a Deployment named echo-deployment. The deployment is exposed using a Service called echo-service. You need to perform an update to the application with minimal downtime to the application. What should you do?

options.A: Use kubectl set image deployment/echo-deployment <new-image>
options.B: Use the rolling update functionality of the Instance Group behind the Kubernetes cluster
options.C: Update the deployment yaml file with the new container image. Use kubectl delete deployment/echo-deployment and kubectl create a€"f <yamI-file>
options.D: Update the service yaml file which the new container image. Use kubectl delete service/echo-service and kubectl create a€"f <yaml-file>

explanations.A: Use kubectl set image deployment/echo-deployment <new-image> 此选项使用 "kubectl set image’ 命令直接更新 Deployment 的镜像。这种方法会触发 Kubernetes 的滚动更新机制，逐步蔡换旧的 Pod，确保应用的可用性。这是 Kubernetes 官方推荐的方式之一，能够实现无颖更新。正确
explanations.B: Use the rolling update functionality of the Instance Group behind the Kubernetes cluster 此选项提到使用 Instance Group 的滚动更新功能，但 Kubernetes 的滚动更新是通过 Deployment 控制的，而不是直接依赖底层的 Instance Group, Instance Group 的滚动更新与 Kubernetes 的 Pod 管理机制无关，因此此选项不适用于 Kubernetes 的应用更新。错误
explanations.C: Update the deployment yaml file with the new container image. Use kubectl delete deployment/echo-deployment and kubectl create a€"f <yaml-file> 此选项建议删除现有的 Deployment 并重新创建一个新的 Deployment。这种方法会导致应用的短暂停机，因为删除 Deployment 会导致所有 Pod 被终止。这种方法不符合题目要求的"最小化停机时间"。错误
explanations.D: Update the service yaml file which the new container image. Use kubectl delete service/echo-service and kubectl create a€"f <yaml-file> 此选项建议更新 Service 的 yaml 文件并重新创建 service，但 Service 仅负责暴露应用的网络访问，并不管理应用的镜像或 Pod。更新 Service 并不能实现应用的镜像更新，因此此选项与题目要求不符。错误

question: Your company is using BigQuery as its enterprise data warehouse. Data is distributed over several Google Cloud projects. All queries on BigQuery need to be billed on a single project. You want to make sure that no query costs are incurred on the projects that contain the data. Users should be able to query the datasets, but not edit them. How should you configure users’ access roles?

options.A: Add all users to a group. Grant the group the role of BigQuery user on the billing project and BigQuery dataViewer on the projects that contain the data.
options.B: Add all users to a group. Grant the group the roles of BigQuery dataViewer on the billing project and BigQuery user on the projects that contain the data.
options.C: Add all users to a group. Grant the group the roles of BigQuery jobUser on the billing project and BigQuery dataViewer on the projects that contain the data.
options.D: Add all users to a group. Grant the group the roles of BigQuery dataViewer on the billing project and BigQuery jobUser on the projects that contain the data.

explanations.B: Add all users to a group. Grant the group the roles of BigQuery dataViewer on the billing project and BigQuery user on the projects that contain the data. 错误原因: BigQuery user 角色在数据项目上授予了编辑权限，这与题目要求的"不能编辑数据"相冲突。此外，BigQuery dataViewer 角色在计费项目上无法运行查询作业。
explanations.C: Add all users to a group. Grant the group the roles of BigQuery jobUser on the billing project and BigQuery dataViewer on the projects that contain the data. 正确原因: BigQuery jobUser 角色允许用户在计费项目中运行查询作业，从而集中计费; BigQuery dataViewer 角色在数据项目上仅授予查看权限，符合"不能编辑数据“的要求。
explanations.D: Add all users to a group. Grant the group the roles of BigQuery dataViewer on the billing project and BigQuery jobUser on the projects that contain the data. 错误原因: BigQuery jobUser 角色在数据项目上授予了运行查询作业的权限，但这会导致查询费用分散在数据项目中，而不是集中在计费项目中。

question: You have developed an application using Cloud ML Engine that recognizes famous paintings from uploaded images. You want to test the application and allow specific people to upload images for the next 24 hours. Not all users have a Google Account. How should you have users upload images?

options.B: Have users upload the images to Cloud Storage using a signed URL that expires after 24 hours.
options.C: Create an App Engine web application where users can upload images. Configure App Engine to disable the application after 24 hours. Authenticate users via Cloud Identity.

Authenticate users via Cloud Identity. 错误: 虽然App Engine可以实现用户上传功能，但使用Cloud Identity进行身份验证要求用户拥有Google账户，这与题目中"部分用户没有Google账户"的条件冲突。此外，禁用App Engine应用程序需要额外的配置，复杂度较高。
explanations.D: Create an App Engine web application where users can upload images for the next 24 hours. Authenticate users via Cloud Identity. 错误: 与选项C类似，Cloud Identity要求用户拥有Google账户，不符合题目条件。App Engine的实现复杂度较高，且不如Signed URL直接满足需求。

question: Your web application must comply with the requirements of the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). You are responsible for the technical architecture of your web application. What should you do?

options.A: Ensure that your web application only uses native features and services of Google Cloud Platform, because Google already has various certifications and provides a€pass-ona€ compliance when you use native features.
options.B: Enable the relevant GDPR compliance setting within the GCPConsole for each of the services in use within your application.

explanations.B: 在 GCP Console 中为您的应用程序使用的每个服务启用相关的 GDPR 合规设置。错误: GCP Console中并没有专门的"GDPR合规设置"。合规性需要通过设计和实施来实现，而不是简单地启用某些设置。
explanations.C: 确保 Cloud Security Scanner 是您测试计划策略的一部分，以发现任何合规性差距。错误: Cloud Security Scanner主要用于检测安全漏洞，而不是专门用于GDPR合规性检查。虽然它可以帮助发现安全问题，但不能替代全面的合规性设计。
explanations.D: 定义一个符合 GDPR 要求的网络应用程序数据安全设计。正确: GDPR要求对数据处理进行全面的设计，包括数据安全性、隐私保护、数据访问控制等。定义一个符合GDPR要求的设计是实现合规性的核心步骤。

question: You are designing an application for use only during business hours. For the minimum viable product release, you'd like to use a managed product that automatically ‘scales to zero’ so you don't incur costs when there is no activity. Which primary compute resource should you choose?

options.A: Cloud Functions ER Cloud Functions
options.B: Compute Engine Compute Engine
options.C: Google Kubernetes Engine Google Kubernetes Engine

question: You are creating an App Engine application that uses Cloud Datastore as its persistence layer. You need to retrieve several root entities for which you have the identifiers. You want to minimize the overhead in operations performed by Cloud Datastore. What should you do?

options.A: Create the Key object for each Entity and run a batch get operation
options.B: Create the Key object for each Entity and run multiple get operations, one operation for each entity
options.C: Use the identifiers to create a query filter and run a batch query operation
options.D: Use the identifiers to create a query filter and run multiple query operations, one operation for each entity

explanations.A: Create the Key object for each Entity and run a batch get operation 正确: 批量获取操作 (Batch Get) 是 Cloud Datastore 提供的一种高效方法，可以通过一次请求获取多个实体，减少网络开销和操作时间。使用 Key 对象直接定位实体，避免了查询操作的额外开销。这是最优解，因为它最小化了操作的开销。
explanations.B: Create the Key object for each Entity and run multiple get operations, one operation for each entity 错误: 虽然可以通过 Key 对象直接获取实体，但每个实体都需要单独的操作，这会增加网络开销和操作时间。相比批量获取操作，这种方法效率较低。
explanations.C: Use the identifiers to create a query filter and run a batch query operation 错误: 查询操作需要额外的过滤和索引处理，开销比直接使用 Key 对象获取实体更大。虽然可以批量查询，但查询操作本身并不是最优选择。
explanations.D: Use the identifiers to create a query filter and run multiple query operations, one operation for each entity 错误: 这种方法不仅需要额外的查询开销，还需要为每个实体单独运行查询操作，效率最低。相比批量查询和批量获取，这种方法完全不符合性能优化的要求。

question: You need to upload files from your on-premises environment to Cloud Storage. You want the files to be encrypted on Cloud Storage using customer-supplied encryption keys. What should you do?

explanations.B: Supply the encryption key using gcloud config. Use gsutil to upload the files to that bucket. 错误。gcloud config 并不支持直接配置客户提供的加密密铀。加密密钥的配置需要通过 .boto 文件或 gsutil 的命令行参数完成。

question: You are using a single Cloud SQL instance to serve your application from a specific zone. You want to introduce high availability. What should you do?

options.A: Create a read replica instance in a different region
options.B: Create a failover replica instance in a different region
options.C: Create a read replica instance in the same region, but in a different zone
options.D: Create a failover replica instance in the same region, but in a different zone ER

explanations.A: Create a read replica instance in a different region 错误: Read replica 的主要用途是分担读取负载，而不是提供高可用性。即使在不同地区创建 read replica，也无法在主实例故障时自动切换到 read replica, 此外，跨区域的 read replica 会增加网络延迟，不适合高可用性场景。
explanations.B: Create a failover replica instance in a different region 错误: BPR failover replica 是用于高可用性，但 Google Cloud SQL 的 failover replica 必须在同一地区 (region) 内的不同区域 (zone) 中创建，跨地区的 failover replica 不受支持。跨地区的 failover replica 会增加复杂性和延迟，不符合 Google Cloud SQL 的设计规范。
explanations.C: Create a read replica instance in the same region, but in a different zone 错误: Read replica 的主要用途是分担读取负载，而不是提供高可用性。即使在同一地区的不同区域创建 read replica，也无法在主实例故障时自动切换到 read replica。此选项无法满足高可用性的需求。
explanations.D: Create a failover replica instance in the same region, but in a different zone 正确: Failover replica 是专门用于高可用性的解决方案。当主实例发生故障时，系统会自动切换到 failover replica, 根据 Google Cloud SQL 的设计，failover replica 必须在同一地区 (region) 内的不同区域 (zone) 中创建，以确保低延迟和高可靠性。

question: Your company pushes batches of sensitive transaction data from its application server VMs to Cloud Pub/Sub for processing and storage. What is the Google- recommended way for your application to authenticate to the required Google Cloud services?

options.B: Ensure that VM service accounts do not have access to Cloud Pub/Sub, and use VM access scopes to grant the appropriate Cloud Pub/Sub IAM roles.

explanations.A: Ensure that VM service accounts are granted the appropriate Cloud Pub/Sub IAM roles. 正确性分析: 这是 Google Cloud 推荐的最佳实践。通过为虚拟机的服务账户分配适当的 IAM 角色，可以确保虚拟机能够安全地访问 Cloud Pub/sub，而无需额外的复杂配置。优点: 服务账户是 Google Cloud 原生的身份认证机制，结合 IAM 角色可以实现细粒度的权限控制。结论: 此选项正确。
explanations.B: Ensure that VM service accounts do not have access to Cloud Pub/Sub, and use VM access scopes to grant the appropriate Cloud Pub/Sub IAM roles. 正确性分析: 访问范围 (Access Scopes) 是较旧的机制，主要用于限制虚拟机对 Google Cloud API 的访问权限。然而，Google Cloud 已经推荐使用IAM 角色代替访问范围进行权限管理。缺点: 这种方法不够灵活，且不符合当前的最佳实践。结论: 此选项错误。
explanations.C: Generate an OAuth2 access token for accessing Cloud Pub/Sub, encrypt it, and store it in Cloud Storage for access from each VM. 正确性分析: 虽然可以通过 OAuth2 令牌进行认证，但这种方法复杂且容易出错。需要额外的加密和存储机制来保护令牌，增加了管理的复杂性。缺点: 不符合 Google Cloud 推荐的服务账户认证机制，且安全性较低。结论: 此选项错误。
explanations.D: Create a gateway to Cloud Pub/Sub using a Cloud Function, and grant the Cloud Function service account the appropriate Cloud Pub/Sub IAM roles. 正确性分析: 虽然可以通过 Cloud Function 创建网关，但这增加了额外的架构复杂性，且不必要。直接使用虚拟机的服务账户即可满足需求。fim: 增加了额外的资源和管理开销，不符合题目要求的简单性和直接性。结论: 此选项错误。

question: Your web application uses Google Kubernetes Engine to manage several workloads. One workload requires a consistent set of hostnames even after pod scaling and relaunches. Which feature of Kubernetes should you use to accomplish this?

options.A: StatefulSets StatefulSets
options.B: Role-based access control Role-based access control
options.C: Container environment variables Container environment variables
options.D: Persistent Volumes Persistent Volumes

explanations.A: Statefulsets StatefulSets 是 Kubernetes 中专门用于管理有状态应用的资源类型。它能够为每个 Pod 提供稳定的网络标识 (ENB)，即使在 Pod 扩展或重启后，主机名仍然保持一致。Alt, StatefulSets 是解决题目中“需要一致的主机名"的正确选择。
explanations.B: Role-based access control (RBAC) RBAC 是 Kubernetes 中用于管理用户和服务账户权限的机制。它与主机名的稳定性无关，因此不适合解决题目中的问题。此选项错误。
explanations.C: Container environment variables 容器环境变量可以为容器提供动态配置，但它无法保证 Pod 的主机名一致性。此选项错误。
explanations.D: Persistent Volumes 持久卷用于为容器提供持久化存储，但它与主机名的稳定性无关。此选项错误。

question: You are using Cloud CDN to deliver static HTTP(S) website content hosted on a Compute Engine instance group. You want to improve the cache hit ratio. What should you do?

options.A: Customize the cache keys to omit the protocol from the key.
options.B: Shorten the expiration time of the cached objects.
options.C: Make sure the HTTP(S) header a€Cache-Regiona€ points to the closest region of your users.
options.D: Replicate the static content in a Cloud Storage bucket. Point CloudCDN toward a load balancer on that bucket.

explanations.A: Customize the cache keys to omit the protocol from the key. 正确性分析: 缓存键是用来标识缓存内容的唯一标识符。如果缓存键中包含协议 (HTTP 或 HTTPS)，可能会导致同一内容因协议不同而被重复缓存，从而降低缓存命中率。通过省略协议，可以减少重复缓存，提高命中率。结论: 此选项正确。
explanations.B: Shorten the expiration time of the cached objects. 正确性分析: 缩短缓存对象的过期时间会导致缓存内容更频繁地被刷新，从而增加缓存的更新频率。这可能会降低缓存命中率，因为内容可能在用户访问时已经过期。结论: 此选项错误。
explanations.C: Make sure the HTTP(S) header a€Cache-Regiona€ points to the closest region of your users. 正确性分析: HTTP(S)头中并没有名为"Cache-Region' 的标准字段。即使有类似的自定义字段，它与提高缓存命中率无直接关系，而是与内容分发的地理位置优化相关。结论: 此选项错误。
explanations.D: Replicate the static content in a Cloud Storage bucket. Point CloudCDN toward a load balancer on that bucket. 正确性分析: 将静态内容存储在 Cloud Storage 并通过负载均衡器指向 Cloud CDN 是一种优化内容分发的策略，但它与提高缓存命中率无直接关系。缓存命中率主要取决于缓存键的设计和内容的有效性，而不是存储位置。结论: 此选项错误。

question: You have an App Engine application that needs to be updated. You want to test the update with production traffic before replacing the current application version. What should you do?

options.B: Deploy the update as a new version in the App Engine application, and split traffic between the new and current versions.

question: You have an application that makes HTTP requests to Cloud Storage. Occasionally the requests fail with HTTP status codes of 5xx and 429. How should you handle these types of errors?

options.A: Use gRPC instead of HTTP for better performance.
options.B: Implement retry logic using a truncated exponential backoff strategy.
options.C: Make sure the Cloud Storage bucket is multi-regional for geo-redundancy.
options.D: Monitor https://status.cloud.google.com/feed.atom and only make requests if Cloud Storage is not reporting an incident.

explanations.A: 使用 gRPC 而不是 HTTP 以获得更好的性能。错误原因: 虽然 9RPC 在某些情况下性能更优，但它并不能解决 HTTP 请求失败的问题，尤其是 5xx 和 429 错误。这些错误通常与服务端的负载或资源限制有关，而不是通信协议的问题。
explanations.B: 使用截断的指数退避策略实现重试逻辑。正确原因: 截断的指数退避策略是处理临时性错误 (如 5xx 和 429 状态码) 的最佳实践。它通过逐步增加重试间隔时间，避免对服务端造成过度压力，同时提高请求成功的可能性。
explanations.C: 确保 Cloud Storage 存储桶是多区域的，以实现地理宛余。错误原因: 多区域存储桶可以提高数据的可用性和宛余性，但它并不能直接解决 HTTP 请求失败的问题。5xx 和 429 错误通常与服务端负载或速率限制相关，而不是存储桶的地理位置问题。
explanations.D: 监控 https://status.cloud.google.comy/feed.atom，并仅在 Cloud Storage 未报告事件时发出请求。错误原因: 虽然监控服务状态是一个好的实践，但仅依赖服务状态报告来决定是否发送请求并不能解决临时性错误的问题。5xx 和 429 错误可能发生在服务正常运行时，因此需要更主动的错误处理策略。

question: Your company creates rendering software which users can download from the company website. Your company has customers all over the world. You want to minimize latency for all your customers. You want to follow Google-recommended practices. How should you store the files?

options.A: Save the files in a Multi-Regional Cloud Storage bucket.
options.B: Save the files in a Regional Cloud Storage bucket, one bucket per zone of the region.
options.C: Save the files in multiple Regional Cloud Storage buckets, one bucket per zone per region.
options.D: Save the files in multiple Multi-Regional Cloud Storage buckets, one bucket per multi-region.

explanations.A: Save the files in a Multi-Regional Cloud Storage bucket. 分析: Multi-Regional Cloud Storage bucket是专为全球分布式访问设计的，数据会自动在多个区域内宛余存储，能够有效降低全球用户的访问延迟。此选项是一个合理的解决方案，但它只提到一个 bucket，可能无法完全覆盖所有全球用户的需求。
explanations.B: Save the files in a Regional Cloud Storage bucket, one bucket per zone of the region. 分析: Regional Cloud Storage bucket仅限于单个区域内存储，无法有效降低全球用户的访问延迟。每个区域的zone存储多个bucket并不会显著提升全球访问性能，因此此选项不符合题目要求。
explanations.C: Save the files in multiple Regional Cloud Storage buckets, one bucket per zone per region. 分析: 此选项扩展了B的思路，但仍然局限于Regional Cloud Storage bucket。虽然多个区域的bucket可以履盖更多地理位置，但它无法提供Multi-Regional Cloud storage的自动元余和全球优化访问性能，因此不符合Google推荐的最佳实践。
explanations.D: Save the files in multiple Multi-Regional Cloud Storage buckets, one bucket per multi-region. 分析: 此选项结合了Multi- Regional Cloud storage的全球分布式存储优势，并通过在多个multi-region创建bucket进一步优化了全球用户的访问延迟。这是 Google推荐的最佳实践，能够最大化降低全球用户的访问延迟。
